teaser: What happens when a life built for command meets a personality built to run the room? Life path 8 asks you to master the material world — money, authority, the weight of decisions that move other people's lives. ESTJ already runs on order, direction, and plain speech. Cross the two and you get someone who does not wait to be handed authority; you assume it, and you are usually right to. The friction is not whether you can lead. It is what gets missed while you are busy being certain.
